title: Thin and duplicate Spotlight pages are in the sitemap

source.ref: SEO, GEO and speed deep scan 2026-11-19 (production crawl of 3,000 URLs, all 720 sitemap pages, 8 crawler user agents, Lighthouse on 14 templates)

detail: Some Spotlight pages in the sitemap have almost nothing on them (/spaces/awesome-possum/spotlight 14 words, /spotlight/aidentyack 17 words). /spotlight/<handle> and /spaces/<slug>/spotlight carry the same title for the same person. /spaces/hq is titled "Frequency · Frequency". 127 event titles run past 65 characters. 16 ended series pages stay indexable with no Event schema (by design, noted for the record). Wanted: a Spotlight with nothing on it stays out of the sitemap and says noindex, one of the two Spotlight addresses is canonical, and the root Space title says the name once.

verify.evidence: Production crawl, 2026-11-19: word counts and titles from the crawl of all 720 sitemap pages; the two Spotlight addresses returned identical title tags.
